summary: The Andersons, Inc. disclosed an 8-K on November 3, 2026 that its wholly owned subsidiary, Andersons Renewables, LLC, entered a Merger and Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding limited partner interests in Harvestone Low Carbon Partners, LP via blocker-entity purchases and a merger of Heartland Merger Sub into HLCP, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. Total purchase price is $915 million, including normalized working capital, subject to adjustments. HLCP operates three low-carbon ethanol facilities in North Dakota and Indiana with roughly 215 million gallons annual capacity. Financing blends long-term debt and revolver borrowings, backed by a commitment letter from U.S. Bank and Farm Credit Mid-America. Closing is targeted Q4 2026 or early Q1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals; the Company guarantees subsidiary obligations. Watch regulatory timing, definitive debt documentation, and purchase-price adjustments.
